title: tshark: show field abbrevs matching a prefix
description:
Proposed fix for bug 10768. Allows an optional extra argument to
`tshark -G fields` which is used as a search prefix; protocol and field
abbreviations that match this prefix are shown in a simplified output
format compared to the base `-G fields` output.

I implemented this using a new function
`proto_registrar_dump_field_completions`, but the functionality could be
rolled into `proto_registrar_dump_fields` with a change to that
function's signature.

Closes #10768

notes.body:
